fr-paris.scope: Covers the city of Paris within its central arrondissements. Versailles and other day trips outside the city are not covered.

experiences.what: world-class art museums and a Gothic cathedral on the Seine island
walking between landmark viewpoints, hilltop village streets and old mansion-lined lanes
bakeries, cheese shops and bistros along pedestrian market streets
grand department stores and fashion boutiques
sitting in formal gardens with fountains and tree-lined paths

jp-tokyo.scope: Covers the central wards of Tokyo. The Tokyo islands and Mount Fuji are not covered.

experiences.what: neon-lit crossings, youth fashion streets and skyscraper districts
a large Buddhist temple with a lantern gate, a forested Shinto shrine and national art collections
sushi and seafood snacks at market stalls and street food under railway arches
luxury flagship stores and multi-storey electronics and anime shops
tiny bars packed into narrow alleys and late-night clubs
strolling landscaped Japanese gardens with ponds and teahouses

us-new-york.scope: Covers New York City at borough level, mainly Manhattan and Brooklyn. The rest of New York State is not covered.

experiences.what: walking a suspension bridge, an elevated rail-line park and a billboard-lit square
encyclopedic and modern art museums and the harbour immigration monuments
pizza slices, bagels, pastrami sandwiches and food hall stalls
stage musicals and plays, and jazz and comedy clubs
lawns, lakes and walking paths in large landscaped parks
flagship stores and cast-iron district boutiques

constraints: The Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island are reached by ferry.
Winters are cold with snow possible, which limits park and outdoor walking experiences.

sg-singapore.scope: Covers the main island of Singapore by neighbourhood. Sentosa is not covered in this draft.

experiences.what: inexpensive cooked dishes such as chicken rice, satay and laksa at open-air hawker centres
walking ethnic quarters with shophouses, temples and a mosque
giant artificial tree structures, cooled glass conservatories and a tropical orchid garden
a long boulevard of air-conditioned malls
riverside bars and restaurants in converted warehouses
museums on the island's history and Southeast Asian art

constraints: Outdoor experiences take place in hot, humid equatorial weather with frequent rain all year.

ae-dubai.scope: Covers experiences inside the city of Dubai. Desert excursions are not covered in this draft.

experiences.what: observation decks on the world's tallest tower, a choreographed fountain and a high-rise waterfront promenade
wind-tower houses in the old quarter and wooden abra boats crossing the creek
a very large mall and traditional gold and spice markets
public sandy beaches on the Gulf with skyline views
an indoor ski slope and large waterparks

constraints: Extreme summer heat, roughly June to September, severely limits beaches, walking and other outdoor experiences.
The main districts are spread far apart along the coast, so moving between the old creek area, downtown and the marina takes a metro or car ride.

tr-istanbul.scope: Covers the districts of Istanbul on both the European and Asian sides, including crossings of the Bosphorus. Cappadocia is not covered.

experiences.what: Byzantine and Ottoman monuments: a domed former basilica, an imperial mosque and a sultans' palace
covered bazaars selling carpets, ceramics, spices and Turkish delight
a medieval stone tower, a pedestrian avenue with a historic tram and colourful hillside houses
ferry rides along the strait past waterfront mansions, fortresses and suspension bridges
fish sandwiches by the water and market streets of meze, pickles and sweets
steam bathing and scrubs in centuries-old Ottoman bathhouses

constraints: Bosphorus sightseeing is done by boat.
The city is split by the strait, so combining the European and Asian sides involves a ferry, metro or bridge crossing.

tw-taipei.scope: Covers Taipei City. Jiufen and other places in neighbouring administrative areas are not covered in this draft.

experiences.what: night market stalls selling fried chicken, pepper buns, oyster omelettes and bubble tea
a major collection of Chinese imperial art, a monumental memorial hall and an ornate working temple
a skyscraper observatory, a pedestrian youth shopping district and an old street of dried-goods and tea shops
soaking in sulphur hot spring baths in a valley district
a short stair hike to a skyline viewpoint and volcanic hills with fumaroles and grassland

constraints: Typhoons and heavy rain in summer and early autumn can disrupt outdoor experiences.
Beitou and Yangmingshan are on the northern edge of the city, a metro or bus ride from the centre.

jp-kyoto.scope: Covers the city of Kyoto. The rest of Kyoto Prefecture and Osaka are not covered.

experiences.what: a hillside path through thousands of vermilion torii gates, a gold-leaf pavilion and a wooden temple terrace
walking preserved lanes of wooden townhouses and teahouses in the geisha districts
a tall bamboo grove by a river and a canal-side path lined with cherry trees
a covered market arcade of pickles, tofu, sweets and seafood skewers

constraints: Cherry blossom in spring and autumn foliage are short seasonal windows; the scenery differs outside them.
Arashiyama, Fushimi Inari and Kinkaku-ji lie on different edges of the city, so combining them takes train or bus transfers.

th-bangkok.scope: Covers central Bangkok, with its markets, temples and riverside. Distant day-trip products outside the city are not covered.

experiences.what: a royal palace compound and riverside temples with a giant reclining Buddha and a porcelain-covered spire
a vast weekend market of thousands of stalls and large air-conditioned malls
street food stalls along the Chinatown main road after dark and a fresh produce market
river express boats and long-tail boats through old canals
a backpacker street of bars and street vendors and a long avenue of clubs and bars
a central park with a lake and shaded paths

constraints: The rainy season, roughly May to October, brings frequent heavy downpours and occasional street flooding.
Heat and humidity are high all year, which limits long daytime walking.

pt-lisbon.scope: Covers the city of Lisbon, including the Belém waterfront. Sintra and Cascais are not covered.

experiences.what: steep lanes of the old Moorish quarter, vintage yellow trams and hilltop terrace viewpoints
Manueline monuments from the Age of Discovery and a hilltop medieval castle
custard tarts from a historic bakery and a food hall of Portuguese stalls
street-side bars on a hilltop grid of lanes, a nightlife street by the river and fado music houses

constraints: The historic districts are built on steep hills with cobbled streets and stairs, which matters for limited mobility.
Belém is several kilometres west of the centre, a tram, train or bus ride away.

au-sydney.scope: Covers central Sydney, the harbour and the city beaches. National parks and other nature areas outside the city, such as the Blue Mountains, are not covered.

experiences.what: the sail-roofed opera house, the steel arch bridge and a sandstone colonial quarter on the harbour
swimming and surfing at ocean beaches with ocean pools
harbourside gardens, headland lookouts and a clifftop coastal path
a harbourside zoo with native animals reached across the water
art and natural history museums
places: Art Gallery of New South Wales

experiences.what: fresh seafood, oysters and sashimi at a working fish market

constraints: Beach swimming is mainly a warm-season experience, roughly November to April.
Manly and Taronga Zoo are across the harbour from the centre and are commonly reached by ferry.

th-phuket-island.scope: Covers the main island of Phuket, limited to Patong, Kata and Karon beaches and Phuket Old Town. Offshore islands and boat tours are not covered.

experiences.what: swimming and sunbathing on long west-coast sandy beaches
walking streets of colourful Sino-Portuguese shophouses, shrines and cafes
a neon-lit walking street of bars, clubs and live music
a hilltop lookout over three bays

constraints: During the southwest monsoon, roughly May to October, west-coast beaches have rough seas and swimming is often unsafe.
Phuket Old Town is on the opposite side of the island from the beaches, a road transfer away.
Offshore islands are reached by boat and are outside this profile.

mx-mexico-city.scope: Covers Mexico City by district. Archaeological sites outside the city, such as Teotihuacan, are not covered in this draft.

experiences.what: a major museum of pre-Hispanic civilisations, excavated Aztec temple ruins and the blue house of a famous painter
a vast colonial main square and leafy districts of art deco buildings, cafes and plazas
tacos al pastor, tamales and market stalls of regional produce and antojitos
a large forested park with lakes and a hilltop castle
rides on painted flat-bottomed boats along ancient canals
mariachi bands playing in a square and masked wrestling shows

constraints: The city lies at about 2,240 metres, and the altitude can affect visitors on arrival.
The rainy season, roughly June to September, brings heavy afternoon showers.
Xochimilco is in the far south of the city, a long transfer from the centre.

ca-vancouver.scope: Covers the city of Vancouver, centred on its urban nature such as Stanley Park. The North Shore mountains and Whistler are not covered in this draft.

experiences.what: walking or cycling a waterfront seawall around a forested peninsula park, and a hilltop garden with skyline views
a Victorian-era district with cobbled streets and a steam clock, and converted warehouse neighbourhoods
a covered public market of seafood, baked goods and produce on a harbour peninsula
city beaches with mountain and bay views
Northwest Coast Indigenous art and totem poles, and a downtown art museum

constraints: Late autumn and winter are persistently rainy, which limits parks, beaches and the seawall.

us-honolulu.scope: Covers urban Honolulu, centred on downtown and Waikiki. The rest of Oahu and the other Hawaiian islands are not covered.

experiences.what: beginner surf lessons and outrigger canoe rides on gentle rolling waves
calm-water swimming and picnicking in beachfront parks
a hike up a volcanic crater to an ocean and city lookout, and a rainforest trail to a waterfall
a royal palace of the Hawaiian monarchy and a museum of Hawaiian and Pacific culture
a large open-air shopping centre and a beachfront avenue of shops
poke, plate lunches and malasada doughnuts

constraints: Honolulu is on an island, so reaching it requires a long flight.
The Diamond Head summit trail is a steep uphill walk with stairs.

in-delhi.scope: Covers the Delhi urban area, including Old Delhi and New Delhi. Sights in other states, such as the Taj Mahal in Agra, are not covered.

experiences.what: Mughal and Sultanate monuments: a red sandstone fort, a garden tomb and a tall medieval minaret
rickshaw rides through crowded bazaar lanes, a colonial-era circular arcade and a ceremonial boulevard with a war memorial arch
Old Delhi street food such as stuffed parathas, kebabs and chaat
handicraft stalls from across India and street markets for textiles and jewellery
walking in landscaped gardens dotted with medieval tombs

constraints: Extreme heat, roughly April to June, limits outdoor sightseeing.
Heavy air pollution and fog in late autumn and winter affect outdoor experiences and visibility.
The monsoon, roughly July to September, brings heavy rain and humidity.

ma-marrakesh.scope: Covers the city of Marrakesh, centred on the medina and its markets. Overnight trips to the Sahara are not covered.

experiences.what: walking the walled old city's lanes, the old Jewish quarter and past a landmark 12th-century minaret
bargaining in covered souks for leather, lamps, carpets and spices
a 19th-century palace with painted ceilings, royal tombs and a tiled Islamic college
evening open-air food stalls with grilled meats, snail soup and orange juice among street performers
a cobalt-blue villa garden of cacti and palms and an olive grove with a reflecting pool

constraints: Summer, roughly June to August, is very hot, which limits daytime walking in the medina.
The medina's narrow lanes are largely inaccessible to cars and are explored on foot.

za-cape-town.scope: Covers the city of Cape Town and nearby experiences such as Table Mountain. Safaris and the Garden Route are not covered.

experiences.what: a flat-topped mountain reached by cable car or hiking trails, a peak hike with city views and a botanical garden on the mountain slopes
a former island prison, a hillside quarter of brightly painted houses and a museum of apartheid-era forced removals
a working harbour precinct of shops and restaurants and a historic public garden
white-sand Atlantic beaches backed by mountain peaks

constraints: The Table Mountain cable car does not operate in strong wind or poor visibility.
Robben Island is reached by boat.
Winter, roughly June to August, is cool, wet and windy; Atlantic beach water is cold all year.

au-cairns.scope: Covers staying in Cairns and day trips that depart from Cairns. The whole Great Barrier Reef and multi-day liveaboard trips are not covered.

experiences.what: day boat trips for snorkelling and diving over coral on nearby reef islands
a cableway over rainforest canopy and a historic mountain railway past a gorge waterfall
swimming in a free saltwater lagoon pool on the waterfront promenade
a weekend market of tropical fruit and local produce
evening stalls of souvenirs and crafts

constraints: Reef snorkelling and diving require a boat trip from Cairns.
Marine stingers are present in coastal waters roughly November to May, limiting unprotected sea swimming.
The wet season, roughly December to April, brings heavy rain and possible cyclones.
Central Cairns has tidal mudflats rather than a swimming beach.

nz-queenstown.scope: Covers Queenstown town and nearby walks and lake experiences. Milford Sound and multi-day treks are not covered.

experiences.what: lakeside walks, a peninsula garden and a hill climb to views of the lake and mountains
bungy jumping from a historic bridge, jet boat rides through a narrow canyon and a gondola with a downhill luge
downhill skiing and snowboarding at nearby ski fields
a lake cruise on a vintage coal-fired steamship

constraints: Skiing is limited to winter, roughly June to early October.
The ski fields are a mountain road drive from town.
Winters are cold with snow and ice, which affects walking tracks.
